espn.enable_note: Enabled 2026-10-01 (UTC) after local canary v2 PASS (docs/evidence/v4/espn-world-cup-canary-v2.json): 104/104 fixtures (72 group + 32 knockout, 7 ESPN season types), 104/104 finished detailed with no abort (2,509 requests), 0 enrichment gaps; national-team identity 48/48 national (16 reused from Nations League by stable ESPN id, 32 founded, 0 clubs, 0 duplicate ESPN ids, 0 name-only merges, 0 guessed flags; Curacao national by competition contract, ESPN isNational=false recorded); groups 12/12 verified against canonical results and fixtures (48 members, no overall table); knockout stages per ESPN type with bracket progression proven (32 edges); 4 shootouts + 5 extra-time results stored from ESPN status + shootoutScore. Partial components: none in the canary; any athlete page ESPN serves as non-JSON is archived and queued (athlete_record_unavailable), never invented.
espn.team_type_basis: Competition contract: the FIFA World Cup admits national teams only. ESPN Core's 2026 record for team 11678 (Curacao) says isNational=false (probed 2026-09-30) while every other entrant says true; a team founded by this lane is national, and an ESPN id already mapped to a club is refused (identity queue).
espn.type_roles_basis: ESPN Core 2026-09-30: fifa.world 2026 season types 1 'Group Stage' (72 events), 2 'Round of 32' (16), 3 'Round of 16' (8), 4 'Quarterfinals' (4), 5 'Semifinals' (2), 6 '3rd-Place Match' (1), 7 'Final' (1). The generic classifier excluded 'Group Stage', so the first rehearsal indexed only the 32 knockout events. Knockout types each become their own canonical stage named by ESPN (stage_per_type).
espn.canary_basis: ESPN Core discovery 2026-09-27: 2026 group stage = type 1 (72 events, groups and standings supported); types 2-7 are named knockout rounds. The group count is sourced at ingest, not assumed. Lane remains disabled pending local canary and national-team identity reconciliation.
